articles.summary: Street Child United today announced its #IAmSomebody Tour, which kicked off in Tacoma, Washington, with stops also planned in Miami, Toronto, New York and Washington, D.C. Street Child United (SCU) is a youth-led global movement using the power of sport to transform how the world sees and treats street-connected young people. The tour will bring SCU Young Leaders from the Street Child World Cup to communities and decision-makers across North America during the FIFA World Cup 2026™
articles.title: Street Child United Announces hashtag # IAmSomebody Tour with Bank of America

articles.summary: For the first time since 2023, a majority of consumers say it's better to buy a home in the current market. According to the latest Bank of America Homebuyer Insights Report, conducted in partnership with Bank of America Institute, 53% of respondents now favor buying over renting or moving in with family (47%).
articles.title: BofA Study: More Americans Favor Buying Over Renting for the First Time Since 2023

articles.summary: As the group stage concludes, Bank of America, the Official Bank of FIFA World Cup 2026™, is launching new collectible beads for its viral BofA Fan Bands, celebrating the tournament’s Round of 16 all the way through to the Final in New York New Jersey.
articles.title: Bank of America Debuts New Knockout Round Beads for Free In-Demand BofA Fan Bands™

articles.summary: The 2026 Bank of America Private Bank Study of Wealthy Americans, surveying individuals with $3 million or more in investable assets, finds that longer lifespans, accelerating family business transitions and shifting investment preferences are reshaping financial priorities. More than 90% cite longevity as a critical planning consideration, while nearly one quarter of business owners report inheriting their companies, highlighting the speed at which multigenerational complexity is emerging.
articles.title: BofA Study Finds Longevity and Accelerating Wealth Transfer Are Making Family Finances More Complex

articles.summary: The Kansas City Current and Bank of America announced a multi-year partnership renewal on Tuesday, set to celebrate community impact and grow the game of soccer nationwide. Bank of America will continue being an official partner of the club as part of the announcement, and the Current will support Bank of America’s landmark global sports program, Sports with Us.
articles.title: Kansas City Current, BofA Announces Multi-Year Partnership Renewal Featuring Enhanced Community Efforts

articles.summary: The Carolina Panthers and Bank of America today announced long-term extension of their naming rights agreement for Bank of America Stadium. The renewal builds on a decades-long relationship between two organizations deeply connected to Charlotte and the Carolinas, extending a naming rights partnership that has become one of the longest-running in the NFL.
articles.title: Bank of America and Carolina Panthers Extend Naming Rights for Bank of America Stadium, Reinforcing Long-Term Commitment to Charlotte and the Carolinas

articles.summary: Bank of America Corporation today announced the Board of Directors has authorized regular cash dividends on the outstanding shares or depositary shares of the following series of preferred stock:
articles.title: Bank of America Declares Preferred Stock Dividends Payable in August and September 2026

articles.summary: As previously announced, Bank of America will report its second quarter 2026 financial results on Tuesday, July 14. The results will be released at approximately 6:45 a.m. ET, followed by an investor conference call at 8:30 a.m. ET.
articles.title: Bank of America to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Host Investor Conference Call on July 14

articles.summary: Al concluir la fase de grupos, Bank of America, el banco oficial de la Copa Mundial de la FIFA 2026, lanza nuevos adornos (charms) coleccionables para sus pulseras virales BofA Fan Bands, celebrando las fases del torneo que van desde los octavos de final hasta la gran final en Nueva York/Nueva Jersey.
articles.title: Bank of America lanza una nueva ronda de adornos para las populares pulseras gratuitas B of A BofA Fan Bands™

articles.summary: Bank of America today announced the addition of several senior investment bankers across its Regional Investment Banking business, reinforcing the company’s commitment to serving middle market clients and expanding coverage in key Local Markets across the U.S. The hires add senior expertise in Austin, Boston, Charlotte, Chicago, Detroit, Minneapolis, New York, San Francisco and West Palm Beach, and they will report to Neil Kell and Samardh Kumar, co-heads of Regional Investment Banking.
articles.title: Bank of America Expands Regional Investment Banking Coverage, Adds Nine Key Senior Hires Across the U.S.

articles.summary: Bank of America reported its second quarter 2026 financial results today. The news release, supplemental filing and investor presentation can be accessed at Bank of America’s Investor Relations website at https://investor.bankofamerica.com/quarterly-earnings.
articles.title: Bank of America Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

articles.summary: Returning Bank of America Chicago Marathon champions Jacob Kiplimo and Hawi Feysa will defend their titles against one of the deepest fields in race history on Sunday, October 11. Announced today, the professional athlete fields feature some of the sport's biggest stars, including Sharon Lokedi, Brigid Kosgei, Amos Kipruto and rising American Charles Hicks.
articles.title: Defending Champions Ready to Take on Stacked Field at 48th Bank of America Chicago Marathon

articles.summary: Bank of America is marking the fifth year of its Breakthrough Technology Dialogue, which brings together a carefully curated group of the world’s most influential CEOs, innovators, investors, academics and scientists to discuss the forces set to bend the arc of our future.
articles.title: Bank of America Marks Five Years of its Breakthrough Technology Dialogue

articles.summary: As the nation prepares to celebrate its 250th anniversary, Bank of America (BofA) is offering free access to 250 cultural and civic institutions to help customers experience and engage with America’s history and culture, through an expansion of the bank’s Museums on Us program.
articles.title: Bank of America Celebrates America 250 by Giving Customers Free Access to 250 Museums and Support for Cultural Programs Nationwide

articles.summary: Bank of America today released its 2026 Workplace Benefits Report (PDF) in partnership with Bank of America Institute, revealing American workers are taking proactive steps to improve their financial wellbeing and save with greater confidence. While economic challenges remain, the report finds that workers at U.S. companies are increasingly turning to their employers to help them build long-term financial stability.
articles.title: B of A BofA Report: Financial Wellbeing of Employees at U.S. Companies Hits Four-Year High, Even as Cost-of-Living Pressures Persist

articles.summary: Bank of America (BofA) today announced enhancements to EricaAssist, its human assisted AI agent that supports employees during client conversations, delivering real time insights that help resolve client needs faster while keeping the employee at the center of the experience.
articles.title: Bank of America Enhances EricaAssist with Generative AI to Help Employees Resolve Client Needs Faster

articles.summary: Bank of America today announced the launch of an enhanced Travel Center, making it easier for clients to plan, book and manage travel. The newly redesigned platform powered by Rocket Travel by Agoda – the strategic partnerships arm of digital travel platform Agoda, a Booking Holdings company – features a wider selection of travel inventory, improved search and filtering capabilities and flexible payment options, including the ability to combine credit card rewards with a credit or debit card payment when booking travel.
articles.title: Book Your Next Getaway: New Bank of America Travel Center Makes it Easier to Plan and Book Memorable Travel Experiences

articles.summary: Bank of America Corporation today announced that the Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend on Bank of America common stock of $0.32 per share, up $0.04 from the prior quarter, an increase of 14%. The dividend is payable on September 25, 2026 to shareholders of record as of September 4, 2026.
articles.title: Bank of America Increases Common Stock Dividend fourteen percent 14% to zero dollars point three two $0.32 Per Share

articles.summary: Bank of America today announced plans to acquire information security specialist MDSec Consulting Limited (“MDSec”). The transaction is expected to be completed during the fourth quarter of 2026 following the receipt of regulatory approvals.
articles.title: Bank of America to Acquire Information Security Consultancy M D Sec MDSec Consulting Limited

articles.summary: Powered by Bank of America, the official bank of the FIFA World Cup 2026 and released during the tournament is a new short film Street of Dreams, which tells the story of a young girl whose life has been upended through homelessness but refuses to give up on her dream of playing soccer. Set to the new U2 track, also titled ‘Street of Dreams’, the film features Bank of America’s Sports with Us Global Ambassador Sir David Beckham to tell an uplifting story about resilience, hope and the transformative power of sport.
articles.title: Bank of America brings together Sir David Beckham and a new U2 song for Street of Dreams , a short film highlighting how support, belief and sport can change a young person’s future.

articles.summary: Merrill today announced that its Managed Account Advisors LLC (MAA) platform surpassed $1 trillion in assets, reflecting two decades of growth and innovation. Since its launch in 2006, MAA has transformed how advisors deliver personalized investment portfolios at scale for clients across the wealth spectrum.
articles.title: Merrill Managed Account Advisors Surpasses one trillion dollars $1 Trillion , Celebrates twenty years 20 Years of Innovation

articles.summary: Bank of America today announced that more than 3 million clients have enrolled in BofA Rewards™ since the program launched on May 27, 2026. The no fee loyalty program rewards and recognizes clients for their full relationship across their Bank of America banking and Merrill investing accounts and is available to any client with a personal checking account.
articles.title: three million plus 3 Million+ Clients Enroll in New B of A BofA Rewards™ Program in First Seven Weeks
